title: 第17章 模拟结束血脉返祖第18章 圣体道胎
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【第五百零六年，叶昌明死于战场，叶家三祖前往了战场，你也被柳家强制带上了战场。
【同年，一次偶然的机会，你被迫反杀了闵家的天元境武者，发现不对的闵家虚神境强者看到了你，此时闵家虚神境强者身上很快衍化出一道虚影，这道虚影身着纯白道袍，面容模糊，散发着浩渺的强大气息，虚空随之扭曲重叠，有所察觉的你堪堪回头，便见到一道亮到极致的刀光向你袭来，刀光很是绚丽，让人着迷，仍你内心如何着急，却怎么都躲不开，你死了。
【评价：这是一次相对成功的人生，你本来可以带领叶家走向新的时代，儿孙满堂，家庭幸福。
你死在了追逐强大的路上，对于更强大的势力来说，你们的生命不值一提。
【你可以使用你的评价积分，兑换以下奖励。
【选项一：境界提升一重，消耗50积分，可重复选择，随着境界不同，消耗积分不同。
【选项二：憾山拳提升至登峰造极，领悟大成憾山拳意，消耗1000积分，可重复选择。
【选项三：获得黄级中品武技‘蜉蝣踏前斩’入门级，消耗1积分，可重复选择。
【选项四：获得永久性天赋‘妙笔生花’，消耗积分800。
【选项五：提升天赋‘天生双魂’，消耗积分230。
【选项六：提升根骨至黄级中品，消耗积分200。
【选项七:获取第三次模拟的记忆，消耗积分500。
（记忆以类似电影模式获得，获取记忆不需要积分，积分用于保护神魂，避免大量信息涌入受到损害）】
看到这次出来的这些选项，叶枫眼光停留在大成憾山拳意这一栏，他现在纠结到底要不要选择，内心他是很想要的，但是这个价格实在是太高了，经过一番考虑，最终他还是暂时放弃了这一栏。
最终他提升了根骨，提升到玄级下品，花费1700积分，提升天赋‘天生双魂’，消耗230积分，永久天赋妙笔生花，花费积分800，同时这一次的记忆他也不打算错过，花费积分500，境界提升到换血境后期。
【花费积分3730，剩余170积分，用于下次模拟抽取天赋，】
也就在叶枫选择完成后，接受了记忆，很快脑海中出现大量的记忆，模拟中的一幕幕快速划过，但又深刻的刻入在脑海，同时叶枫的身体快速的发生着变化，整个人已经不是一米五，而是来到了一米七的身高，之后因为年龄的原因就再也无法变高，同时身上出现了常年熏陶才有的儒雅气质，显得格外的迷人。
叶枫的属性也在极快的变化，最终变成了这样。
content_en:
[In the 506th year, Ye Changming died on the battlefield. The three ancestors of the Ye family went to the battlefield. You were also forced to go to the battlefield by the Liu family.
[In the same year, by chance, you were forced to kill the Tianyuan realm warriors of the Min family. The Xushen realm warrior of the Min family, who discovered something was wrong, saw you. At this time, a shadow quickly emerged from the Min family's Xushen realm warrior. This shadow was dressed in pure white Taoist robes and had a blurry face. It exudes a vast and powerful aura, and the void twists and overlaps. When you notice it, you can turn around and see an extremely bright sword light coming towards you. The sword light is very gorgeous and fascinating. Even though you are anxious in your heart, you can't avoid it. You are dead.
[Simulation ends, overall score: 3900]
[Evaluation: This is a relatively successful life. You could have led the Ye family to a new era, with children and grandchildren, and a happy family.
You died in the pursuit of strength. To more powerful forces, your lives are not worth mentioning.
[You can use your evaluation points to redeem the following rewards.
[Option 1: To raise the realm by one level, it consumes 50 points. It can be selected repeatedly. The points consumed vary with the realm.
[Option 2: Upgrade Hanshan Fist to the pinnacle, comprehend the meaning of Dacheng Hanshan Fist, consume 1,000 points, and can be selected repeatedly.
[Option 3: Obtain the entry-level yellow-level mid-level martial skill ‘Mayfly Stomp’, which consumes 1 point and can be selected repeatedly.
[Option 4: Obtain the permanent talent ‘Wonderful Writing’, which consumes 800 points.
[Option 5: Improve the talent ‘Born with Two Souls’, which consumes 230 points.
[Option 6: Upgrade the root bone to yellow-level mid-grade, consuming 200 points.
[Option 7: Obtain the memory of the third simulation, consuming 500 points.
(Memories are obtained in a movie-like mode. Points are not required to obtain memories. Points are used to protect the soul and avoid damage due to the influx of information)]
Seeing the options that came out this time, Ye Feng's eyes stayed on the column of Dacheng Hanshan Quanyi. He was now struggling with whether to choose. He really wanted it in his heart, but the price was too high. After some consideration, he finally gave up on this column temporarily.
In the end, he upgraded his bones to the lower level of Xuan level, which cost 1,700 points. He upgraded the talent "Born with Two Souls", which cost 230 points. The permanent talent was brilliant, which cost 800 points. At the same time, he did not intend to miss the memory this time. He spent 500 points and upgraded to the late stage of the blood exchange realm.
[Spent 3730 points, and the remaining 170 points will be used for the next simulation to draw talents,]
Just after Ye Feng completed his selection and accepted the memory, a large number of memories soon appeared in his mind. The scenes in the simulation passed quickly but were deeply engraved in his mind. At the same time, Ye Feng's body changed rapidly. He was no longer 1.5 meters tall, but now 1.7 meters tall. After that, he could no longer grow taller due to age. At the same time, he had an elegant temperament that he had cultivated for many years, making him particularly charming.
Ye Feng's attributes also changed extremely quickly, and finally became like this.
